description:
Thank you for your interest in the EverVent Floor register by Platsun. We're looking for partners to help us promote the product in Canada. Ideally between 4k-30k followers, but if you're not in that range, feel free to apply anyway.

The only hard requirements are that you are in Canada, promoting for a Canadian audience, and that you have central air with a 4x10" opening for your floor register.

Below is some more info regarding the product.

You can also check out our website: Platsun.com


🌬️ Product Overview: EverVent Floor Register

EverVent is a multi-purpose floor register designed to improve indoor air quality effortlessly.

Key Features:

  • Dual Functionality: Combines air filtration and passive humidification in one unit.
  • No Electricity Required: Operates without power, integrating seamlessly with existing HVAC systems.
  • Easy Installation: Fits standard 4x10" floor vent openings—no tools needed.
  • Top-Fill Reservoir: Allows for quick, mess-free water refills.
  • Child-proof features: hidden screw holes to secure the vent to the floor.
  • Replaceable Filter Pads: Traps dust, pet hair, and contaminants while adding moisture to the air. (replace every 3-6 months, depending on level of contamination)

Benefits:

  • Enhanced Comfort: Maintains optimal humidity levels, reducing dry skin, nasal discomfort, and nighttime coughing.
  • Healthier Air: Filters out dust, promoting better respiratory health.
  • Optional Fragrance: Add essential oils for a nice smell.
  • Low Maintenance: Simple upkeep with long lasting replaceable filters and no complex parts.

🎯 Target Audience

  • Homeowners and Renters: Seeking affordable, non-invasive air quality improvements.
  • Parents: Looking to create a comfortable environment for children and infants.
  • Pet Owners: Aiming to reduce pet hair and dander circulation.
  • Plant Enthusiasts: Desiring consistent humidity levels for indoor plants.
  • DIY Renovators: Interested in easy home upgrades that enhance comfort and health.

📣 Promotional Tips & Limitations

  • Highlight Unique Selling Points: Emphasize the dual functionality, energy-free operation, and health benefits.
  • Use Visuals: Incorporate product images and lifestyle photos to showcase real-life applications.
  • Share Personal Experiences: If you've used EverVent, share your story to build trust with your audience.
  • Targeted Content: Create content tailored to specific audiences—parents, pet owners, plant enthusiasts, etc.
  • Limitations: Currently only available in Canada, also not every size is available, refer to the website to see which sizes are available.

We look forward to a successful partnership in promoting healthier living spaces with EverVent!
